bugs.title: done_prepare convergence invariant rejects legitimate pre-TEST reviewer re-attestations and makes DONE unreachable

evidence.symptom: done_prepare reached all PASS closure rows then threw done_prepare convergence invariant failed with reviewerReattestations=4
reproSteps: Observe successfulCloseout=1 but hard failure solely because reviewerReattestations=4
evidence.rootCause: assertDonePreparePassConvergence treated legitimate historical reviewer re-attestation telemetry as a zero-only closeout invariant, making any re-reviewed story permanently unable to reach DONE
evidence.fixEvidence: Commit edf2d243ac keeps reviewerReattestations observable but removes it from hard-fail predicate; build, flow-stability smoke, and process-fact contract pass while metadata rollback, human confirmation, duplicate suite, and failed closeout remain blocking

bugs.title: REVIEW Prompt Envelopes become unverifiable after mandatory REVIEW-to-TEST transition while done_prepare incorrectly reports DONE ready

evidence.symptom: Both round-23 and round-24 reviewer Prompt Envelopes verified in REVIEW but story_advance DONE rejected all four after mandatory REVIEW-to-TEST transition while done_prepare reported PASS.
reproSteps: Create signed reviewer runs and passes in REVIEW and verify envelopes
Advance to TEST without unrelated story semantic changes
Run done_prepare then story_advance DONE and observe stale_closeout_review on every lane
evidence.rootCause: fullTaskSemanticDigest included mutable Story.phase, so REVIEW-to-TEST changed taskSemanticDigest and derived eligibility fields despite unchanged model-relevant task semantics.
evidence.fixEvidence: Commit 98173017e5 canonicalizes digest phase to REVIEW while actual phase remains in prompt rendering and title, description, priority, checklist, verification intent, and scope remain fail-closed inputs. Registry, docs, and verifier synchronized.
evidence.reproTest: node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.js --cutoff-verifier-only PASS: REVIEW-to-TEST snapshot and DONE oracle agree, old phase-sensitive mutation differs, title/checklist mutations fail closed; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs PASS
